notes: HealthStack is a Django 4.1 app (server-rendered templates) on SQLite, run with `manage.py runserver` on PORT (4452). Python 3.11.14 is pinned in mise.toml; the venv is .ui-capture/venv. Install uses .ui-capture/requirements.txt, which is the repo's requirements.txt with djangorestframework 3.14.0 instead of 3.15.2 (3.15.2 needs Django>=4.2 and conflicts with the pinned Django 4.1.13) plus djangorestframework-simplejwt 5.2.2 (README step 5). The settings overlay .ui-capture/ui_settings.py imports healthstack.settings and changes only these things: ALLOWED_HOSTS, debug-toolbar hidden, file email backend, the CDN-rewrite middleware, the SSLCommerz stub URLs, and a working DB path (.ui-capture/data/db.sqlite3). Two broken asset references in the repo's templates were fixed so every page loads with no failed requests. templates/patient-login.html loaded js/Normal/Checkbox.js, a file that was never committed. Its show-password function, myFunction11, is already defined inline in the same page, so the dead <script> tag was removed. search.html, search-hospitals.html, hospital-doctor-list.html and hospital-doctor-register.html had a missing slash in the datetimepicker stylesheet path (css/Normalbootstrap-... instead of css/Normal/bootstrap-...). On every start, start.sh runs reset_and_seed.sh: it copies the repo's bundled db.sqlite3 (the original team demo data), runs migrate, then runs seed.py (Django ORM, fixed RNG). The seed replaces lorem-ipsum text and extends the data, with dates relative to the current day. Result: 8 hospitals (Square, Labaid, United, Evercare, DMCH, ...) with departments, specializations and services; 20 doctors (accepted, pending and rejected) with education and experience; 44 patients; about 215 appointments over the last 8 months plus upcoming ones (pending, confirmed, cancelled, paid and unpaid); 65 prescriptions with medicines and tests; 69 lab reports with specimen and test results; about 235 SSLCommerz payments (appointment, test, pharmacy, and a few failed); 36 pharmacy medicines (one out of stock); pharmacy orders and an open cart; doctor reviews; patient-doctor chat threads. Main login is patient 'fayaz' (Fayaz Rayhan) at /login/, which lands on /patient-dashboard/ (appointments, prescriptions, medical records, billing tabs).
